overview.title: About Enagic
overview.content:
Enagic International is a Japanese company founded in 1974 in Okinawa, Japan by Hironari Ohshiro. For over 50 years, Enagic has been the global leader in water ionization technology, manufacturing medical-grade water ionizers that transform ordinary tap water into Kangen Water® - alkaline, hydrogen-rich, antioxidant water.

Headquartered in Okinawa with manufacturing facilities in Osaka, Enagic operates in over 40 countries worldwide through a network of authorized independent distributors. The company's mission is to provide 'True Health' through the power of water, combining cutting-edge Japanese engineering with a commitment to quality and sustainability.

founder.title: Founder: Hironari Ohshiro
founder.content: Hironari Ohshiro, born in Okinawa, Japan, founded Enagic in 1974 with a vision to improve people's health through water. His philosophy of 'True Health' - achieving wellness through natural means - continues to guide the company today. Under his leadership, Enagic grew from a small Okinawan company to a global enterprise with millions of satisfied customers worldwide.

headquarters.content:
Headquarters: 1-3-1 Higashi, Urasoe-shi, Okinawa 901-2103, Japan

mission.title: Mission & Philosophy
mission.content:
Mission: 'To provide True Health to people worldwide through Kangen Water®'

Core Philosophy:

  • True Health: Wellness achieved through natural means - clean water, balanced nutrition, and healthy lifestyle
  • Quality First: Japanese manufacturing excellence with medical-grade standards
  • Sustainability: Eco-friendly products that reduce plastic bottle waste
  • Empowerment: Enabling independent distributors to build their own businesses

india_presence.title: Enagic in India
india_presence.content:
Enagic entered the Indian market in 2017 through a network of authorized independent distributors. India represents a rapidly growing market for Kangen Water®, with increasing awareness about alkaline water benefits and water quality concerns.

Key Highlights:

  • Growing network of authorized distributors across major cities
  • Local customer support and service centers
  • Machines compatible with Indian voltage (230V) and water conditions
  • GST-compliant billing and warranty support
  • Training and certification programs for distributors

K.D Kangen Water is an authorized independent distributor of Enagic products in India, committed to providing genuine Enagic machines, filters, and accessories with full warranty and after-sales support.

manufacturing.title: Japanese Manufacturing Excellence
manufacturing.content:
All Enagic water ionizers are designed and manufactured in Japan at the company's Osaka facility. Key manufacturing highlights:

  • Medical-grade production: ISO 13485 certified facility
  • Platinum-coating technology: Proprietary process for durable, high-performance electrodes
  • Rigorous testing: Every unit tested for pH, ORP, flow rate, and safety before shipping
  • Quality control: Multi-stage inspection process with traceability
  • Environmental responsibility: ISO 14001 certified, RoHS compliant

history.title: Enagic & Kangen Water® History
history.content:
The Evolution of Water Ionization Technology

Enagic's journey spans over five decades of innovation in water technology, transforming from a small Okinawan company to the global leader in medical-grade water ionization.

1974 - Foundation

Hironari Ohshiro founded Enagic in Okinawa, Japan with a vision to improve people's health through water technology. The company began researching water ionization based on Japanese medical studies from the 1930s showing health benefits of electrolyzed water.

1980s - Early Development

Enagic developed its first commercial water ionizers for hospitals and medical facilities in Japan. These early models were adopted by over 200 Japanese hospitals for patient care and surgical preparation.

1994 - Japanese Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare Approval

Enagic water ionizers received official approval as ‘Medical Devices’ (Managed Medical Device Class II) from the Japanese MHLW. This government recognition confirmed the health benefits of Kangen Water® per Japanese regulations.

2000s - Global Expansion

Enagic began international expansion, establishing offices in the USA (Los Angeles), Taiwan, Korea, and across Asia. The company achieved ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 13485 certifications for quality, environmental, and medical device management systems.

2003 - Leveluk SD501 Launch

The iconic Leveluk SD501 was introduced, becoming the world’s most popular and trusted water ionizer model with 7 platinum-coated titanium plates. It set the industry standard for reliability and performance.

2010s - Certifications & Recognition

  • 2011: WQA Gold Seal Certification (USA)
  • 2013: NSF/ANSI 42 & 53 filter certifications
  • 2015: ISO 13485 Medical Device Quality Management certification
  • 2017: Enagic India operations begin
  • 2019: Leveluk K8 flagship model launch with 8 platinum plates

2020s - Continued Innovation

  • 2020: 50th Anniversary celebrated globally
  • 2022: Over 1 million machines sold worldwide
  • 2024: Expanded presence in 40+ countries with 200+ Japanese hospitals using Enagic systems

Today: Enagic remains the only water ionizer company with Japanese MHLW medical device approval, ISO 13485 certification, WQA Gold Seal, and NSF/ANSI certified filters - manufacturing all products in Japan with 50+ years of continuous innovation.
